routineRecall.notEnough: Not enough reminders done yet today

routineRecall.instruction: Tap them in the order you did them today
routineRecall.correct: Wonderful! That is exactly how today went.

1.2: Keep going, you can do it.

celebrate.2: Well played! Great to see you today!

quickTap.step1: First you see one picture. Remember it — this is the picture to catch.
quickTap.step2: Then pictures appear one at a time in the middle of the screen.
quickTap.step3: When you see your picture, tap the screen quickly.
quickTap.step4: For any other picture, don't tap. Tapping other pictures takes points away.

pathMatch.step1: Numbered circles are spread across the screen.
pathMatch.step2: Tap circle 1, then circle 2. A line joins them.
pathMatch.step3: Keep going in order — 3, 4, 5 — until every circle is joined.
pathMatch.step4: In higher levels there is a timer. Take your time; accuracy matters most.

countingBoxes.step1: A stack of boxes appears for a few seconds.
countingBoxes.step2: Count every box, including the ones stacked behind or on top.
countingBoxes.step3: When the boxes disappear, enter how many you counted.
